articles.title: Gurugram sessions court grants a 7-day remand to Punjab Minister Sanjeev Arora
articles.summary: Punjab Minister Sanjeev Arora has been granted a seven-day remand to the Enforcement Directorate (ED) by the Gurugram sessions court. The ED presented Arora before the court, initially seeking a 10-day remand for ongoing investigations. This development involves a state minister and a central investigative agency, highlighting legal proceedings at the national level.

articles.title: Technology collaboration at the heart of PM Modi's Europe outreach next week
articles.summary: Prime Minister Modi's visit to the Netherlands aims to expand India's semiconductor partnership, focusing on collaboration with ASML, a global leader in chipmaking equipment. This initiative highlights India's strategic push for self-reliance in critical technologies. For SSB aspirants, this signifies India's commitment to strengthening its technological base and economic growth through international cooperation, crucial for national development and strategic capabilities across various sectors.

articles.title: Putin says presented war update to India, China, US, paving way for three-day Ukraine ceasefire
articles.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin has provided a situational update on the ongoing Ukraine conflict to key global powers: India, China, and the United States. This engagement signals Russia's intent to communicate directly with major nations regarding the conflict's status and future implications. For an SSB aspirant, this highlights the complex nature of international diplomacy and the strategic importance of inter-state communication amidst significant geopolitical events.

articles.summary: Hal Abelson's witty quote playfully inverts Newton's famous saying, suggesting that instead of seeing further, one might feel overwhelmed or even hindered by the immense body of existing knowledge and the legacy of 'giants'. articles.title: The submariner-turned-top Army tech boss said the hardest thing about modernizing isn't the new tools — it's the people
articles.summary: The Army's former Chief Information Officer, Leonel Garciga, highlighted the significant challenges in getting military personnel to adapt to new technologies. He discussed strategies for successfully integrating advanced systems, underscoring the critical need to overcome resistance for modernizing defence capabilities. This insight is vital for ensuring effective technological leverage in military operations and enhancing national security.
